title: Fixed tensor presentations and their pullback law
statement: Define a fixed tensor presentation by its localization q, representative class P, ordinary and derived tensor functors t and T, and the representative isomorphism r. Define pullback data by A, F, the exact factors f, preservation hA, and the two tensor maps mF and phiF. Their law is exactly the usual representative equation. All fields are explicit input data.
